arrival.speaker: halden
arrival.text: Serene sent you? I'm not so frail that I need someone counting my aches.

arrival.speaker: caelan
arrival.text: She sent the medicine you asked about last week.

arrival.speaker: halden
arrival.text: I said I'd think about asking.

arrival.speaker: tomas
arrival.text: That's practically a yes, for you.

arrival.speaker: halden
arrival.text: And which one of you came to do actual work?

reminder.speaker: halden
reminder.text: The three sacks by the door need moving to the dry pallet. Take them one at a time.

reminder.speaker: tomas
reminder.text: I'll take the middle one. Just say when.

conclusion.speaker: halden
conclusion.text: I spent forty years carrying these myself.

conclusion.speaker: caelan
conclusion.text: Then perhaps you've earned the right to let someone else carry a few.

conclusion.speaker: halden
conclusion.text: Hmph. Tell Serene I'll take the medicine.

conclusion.speaker: halden
conclusion.text: And if she asks, the wheel's been making a dreadful racket. I'll have it looked at.

conclusion.speaker: tomas
conclusion.text: Mira would know what to do.

conclusion.speaker: caelan
conclusion.text: Maybe. If Halden asks for help.

goodbye.speaker: tomas
goodbye.text: I'd better get back. Serene said she'd need another pair of hands.

goodbye.speaker: caelan
goodbye.text: Go on. And try not to turn the courtyard into a workshop.
